Play your own audio through a Tapo camera speaker. C210 is the primary model.

The app follows the system language. English is the default. Turkish is used when the system language is Turkish.

## Download

- Android: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0.apk`
- Windows x64: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-win.zip`
- Linux x64: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-x86_64.AppImage` and `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-amd64.deb`
- Linux arm64: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-arm64.AppImage` and `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-arm64.deb`
- macOS Apple silicon: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-arm64-mac.zip`
- macOS Intel: `Tapo.Ses-0.2.0-mac.zip`

On Android, install the APK and allow installation from this source if the phone asks. The phone and the camera must be on the same network.

On macOS, if Gatekeeper reports the app as damaged, right-click `Ac.command` and choose Open.

## This version

- Android, Windows, Linux, and macOS are all 0.2.0.
- The desktop window is a camera list, a playback deck, and a sound library.
- MP3, WAV, M4A, and OGG are converted to 8 kHz mono PCMA.
- Audio goes to the camera talk channel on TCP port 8800.
- Sign in with the Tapo account password. The RTSP password is not accepted. The password stays on the device.
- One playback is limited to 90 seconds.
